grounds.title: Mollwitz
grounds.place: Mollwitz (Małujowice), 9 km west of Brieg, Silesia
grounds.about: open, almost level farmland between long street villages; a few small woods; streams and ditches

grounds.title: Brieg
grounds.place: Brieg (Brzeg) on the Oder, Silesia: the fortress town and its approaches
grounds.about: fortress town on the south bank of the Oder; flat ground to the south and west; the river and its meadows to the north

grounds.title: Neisse
grounds.place: Neisse (Nysa) on the Glatzer Neisse, Silesia: the fortress and the river
grounds.about: fortress town on the Neisse; river meadows; rising ground to the south and west

grounds.title: Glogau
grounds.place: Glogau (Głogów) on the Oder, Lower Silesia: the fortress and the cathedral island
grounds.about: fortress town on the south bank of the Oder; marshy river meadows; flat ground to the south

grounds.title: Chotusitz
grounds.place: Chotusitz (Chotusice), 5 km north of Czaslau (Čáslav), Bohemia
grounds.about: open, gently rolling Bohemian farmland round Chotusitz; Sehuschitz and its park to the north; brooks and ponds; Czaslau 5 km south, off the field

grounds.title: Prague
grounds.place: Prague (Praha): the walled city on both banks of the Vltava
grounds.about: a great walled city astride the Vltava; the castle hill and Petřín above the left bank; vineyards east of the New Town

grounds.title: Leuthen
grounds.place: Leuthen (Lutynia), 15 km west of Breslau, Silesia
grounds.about: low rolling farmland west of Breslau; long villages; low rises (Butterberg, Sophienberg) and small woods; ponds at Gohlau

grounds.title: Linz
grounds.place: Linz on the Danube, Upper Austria: the town, the bridge and Urfahr
grounds.about: walled town on the south bank of the Danube under the castle hill; wooded heights north of the river; flat ground south and east

kinds.river crossing: a river across the field along its lowest line, a village at the crossing
kinds.vineyards: terraced vines on the sunny slopes
kinds.marsh: wet meadow and reed in the low ground, a brook through it
kinds.wooded hills: woods over the higher and steeper ground
